changes.title: Legend text
items: A legend's quest is done when you put down the right kind's sigil inside its circle; the animal just walking in no longer counts
The legend circle's helper text is rewritten: shorter and plainer, and it says exactly what to do

changes.title: Leaf jitter hue
items: Some trees now drift toward their own autumn colour (gold, orange, red, crimson or purple), and the hue shift you couldn't see at night now shows
The pause page's Leaf jitter sliders go much further: hue up to 180 degrees, so any colour

changes.title: Pack aim
items: Pack combat: animals in a pack no longer miss you as you walk away: their bolts lead you properly, and the ones right beside you lunge too
